units.text: Aspose.Note FOSS for Python reads .one files and writes .pdf files. It converts documents by loading them with aspose.note.Document and saving them with Document.Save using SaveFormat.Pdf or PdfSaveOptions. It extracts content such as images, attached files, tables, and rich text with formatting and tags from loaded documents.

It parses OneNote documents from file paths or binary streams into a document object model, supporting pages, outlines, outline elements, rich text, images, tables, and attached files without requiring Microsoft OneNote or COM automation.

It extracts rich text content and per-run formatting including bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, superscript, subscript, font name, font size, font color, and hyperlinks through TextRun and TextStyle objects.
It extracts embedded images and attached files by providing access to their bytes, file names, and metadata, enabling direct saving to disk.
It inspects tables through rows, cells, and columns, and reads OneNote tags such as yellow star, question mark, and musical note attached to text, images, and tables.
It exports documents to PDF format using SaveFormat.Pdf or PdfSaveOptions, supporting page range control via PageIndex and PageCount settings.
It traverses the document tree using CompositeNode.GetChildNodes for type-based node search or the DocumentVisitor pattern for comprehensive node-by-node processing.
It inspects numbered lists by exposing list format, number format, and restart behavior through the NumberList object attached to outline elements.
It handles document metadata through page properties such as title, author, creation time, and level, plus revision history via PageHistory and Document.GetPageHistory.
This example opens a OneNote file named SimpleTable.one and saves it as a PDF document named out.pdf using the SaveFormat.Pdf option.
The following workflows demonstrate reading, inspecting, and exporting OneNote documents using Aspose.Note FOSS for Python.
Save embedded images to disk.
Load a document from a binary stream.
Traverse tables, rows, and cells.
Extract attached files from a document.
Inspect OneNote tags on text.
Count nodes using a DocumentVisitor.
Extract all text from a document.
Export to PDF with custom options.
Extract hyperlinks from text runs.
Inspect numbered list properties.

The primary entry point is aspose.note.Document, which loads a .one file and exposes its pages as a tree of nodes; Document.Save() writes the document to PDF. The supported public entry points are aspose.note and aspose.note.saving.

The aspose.note.Document class loads a OneNote file from a path or a binary stream, exposes its pages via iteration, provides GetPageHistory to access page version history, and writes the document to PDF using Save with SaveFormat.Pdf or PdfSaveOptions.

The aspose.note.Page class represents a page in a OneNote document, provides access to its Title, and supports cloning; aspose.note.PageHistory manages page versions with methods such as Add and Remove and exposes a Current property, while aspose.note.Title holds the page's title text, date, and time as RichText nodes.

The aspose.note.RichText class holds formatted text with a Text property, a list of TextRun objects, and styling via TextStyle; it supports text manipulation methods such as Append, Insert, Remove, and Replace, and exposes alignment, tags, and paragraph style.

The aspose.note.Image class represents an embedded image, exposing its FileName, raw Bytes, and dimensions, and supports tags and alternative text; examples show how to extract and save images from a document.
The aspose.note.Table class represents a table with columns and cells, exposing its Columns and border visibility; examples show how to iterate over tables, rows, and cells to extract cell text.
The aspose.note.AttachedFile class represents an attached file, exposing its FileName and raw Bytes, and supports tags; examples show how to extract and save attached files from a document.
The aspose.note.SaveFormat enumeration lists supported output formats; currently only Pdf is supported, producing .pdf files.
The aspose.note.saving module provides PdfSaveOptions for PDF export, exposing options such as JpegQuality and ImageCompression, though only page range settings affect output.

The aspose.note.DocumentVisitor class enables custom traversal of a document's node tree via visitor methods such as VisitPageStart, VisitRichTextStart, and VisitImageStart; examples show how to count pages, rich text nodes, and images.
The aspose.note.NumberList class represents a numbered list, exposing properties such as Format, NumberFormat, and Restart; examples show how to inspect numbered list settings on outline elements.
The aspose.note.NoteTag class represents a OneNote tag, exposing its Label, Status, and Icon; examples show how to iterate over tags attached to rich text nodes.

The aspose.note.exceptions module defines exceptions such as FileCorruptedException, IncorrectPasswordException, UnsupportedFileFormatException, and UnsupportedSaveFormatException, which are raised when loading or saving documents encounters unsupported or invalid data.
It adds full read/write support (including writing OneNote files back out), broader format conversion, and wider OneNote compatibility beyond what this free edition covers.
AttachedFile class holds the file name, raw bytes, and tags of an attached file.
Document class represents a OneNote document and provides methods to detect layout changes, get page history, and save the document.
DocumentVisitor class provides methods to visit document, page, outline, outline element, rich text, image, and title nodes.
FileCorruptedException class represents an error raised when a file is corrupted.
FileFormat enum lists the OneNote file format values: OneNote2007, OneNote2010, OneNoteOnline, and Unknown.
HorizontalAlignment enum lists the horizontal alignment values: Left, Center, and Right.
Image class holds the image bytes, file name, file path, format, original dimensions, alignment, and tags of an image.
IncorrectDocumentStructureException class represents an error raised when a document structure is incorrect.
IncorrectPasswordException class represents an error raised when a document password is incorrect.
License class provides a method to set the license.
LoadOptions class holds options for loading a document.
Metered class provides a method to set the metered key.
Node class provides methods to accept a visitor, and read-only properties for the document and parent node.
NodeType enum lists the node type values: AttachedFile, Document, Image, Outline, OutlineElement, Page, RichText, and Table.
NoteTag class holds the creation time, completed time, icon, label, font color, highlight, and status of a note tag.
NumberList class provides a method to get the number list header.
Outline class represents an outline node.
OutlineElement class represents an outline element node.
Page class provides a method to clone the page.
PageHistory class provides methods to add, remove, clear, and query pages, and a read-only property for the current page.
ParagraphStyle class provides a method to get the default style and a read-only property for the font style.
RichText class provides methods to append, insert, clear, and replace text, and properties for alignment and title date.
SaveFormat enum lists the save format value: Pdf.
Table class holds the columns and tags of a table.
TableCell class represents a table cell node.
TableColumn class represents a table column.
TableRow class represents a table row node.
TagStatus enum lists the tag status values: Completed, Disabled, and Open.
TextRun class represents a text run node.
TextStyle class provides methods to get default styles and properties for font color, font name, font size, and font style.
Title class holds the title text, title date, and title time of a page title.
UnsupportedFileFormatException class represents an error raised when a file format is unsupported, and holds the file format.
UnsupportedSaveFormatException class represents an error raised when a save format is unsupported.
AsposeNoteError class is the base exception class for Aspose.Note errors.
CompositeNode class provides methods to append, insert, and remove child nodes, and read-only properties for the first and last child.
PdfSaveOptions class represents options for saving a document to PDF.
SaveOptions class provides a read-only property for the save format.
